run_openevolve_trials: run multiple OpenEvolve trials with different seeds and collect success rate statistics
run_single_trial: run a single OpenEvolve trial with a specific seed and max iterations
parse_trial_logs: parse OpenEvolve log files to extract best score and solution iteration
generate_trial_summary: generate a JSON summary of trial results including success rate and average iterations
run_trials_with_cli: run OpenEvolve trials from the command line using --trials --iterations and --seed flags
